description: One turn of an AI conversation (user prompt or streamed assistant answer) built from ordered parts, with its lifecycle status, error, model, the cited sources, the reader's feedback, the follow-up suggestions and the superseded versions a Regenerate replaced (ActiveVersionIndex selects the rendered one; the live Parts are always the last version). Mutable by design because the delta stream grows it — fold deltas through AiMessageStreamApplier rather than editing parts by hand.
